title: Opening a part sale never asks the over-credit question
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds Net 30, has a credit limit of $500.00 and unpaid invoices totalling $600.00.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S9-03 Customer.
  • Starting screen: Parts, Part Sales.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Part Sale".
  2. Pick {Customer-A} as the customer.
  3. Confirm the New Part Sale window.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the New Part Sale window opens.
  • Step 2: the window shows {Customer-A} as the customer.
  • Step 3: no over-credit confirmation opens (as before the release); the new part sale opens and shows the "Over limit" badge.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning)

  • S9-R4: “Opening a part sale shows no over-credit confirmation, as today; for part sales only the 'Over limit' badge follows S9-R1.”
  • S9-R2: “The "Over limit" badge on work orders and part sales follows the same rule as S9-R1.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
